Overview

Osorno is a city in LL with a population of 170,000. A southern Chilean city with strong German heritage, known for its dairy industry and nearby volcano. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
